messages:
Sam: Quick heads-up — OrchidBank SIG questionnaire is due next Tue EOD. They sent the v5 spreadsheet and want field-by-field evidence. Can we split ownership? I created a folder and linked the sheet: https://drive.company/rdw/orchidbank/sig-v5
Ashwin: On it. I can take encryption, key rotation, and incident response controls. Will pull KMS policy + rotation logs.
Maria: I’ll own SOC2, PSIRT/IR runbooks, and the architecture diagram. Uploading SOC2 bridge letter and the arch diagram to the folder by 15:00 today.
Tay: I’ll cover network isolation, tenant separation, and deployment diagrams for Dedicated/Private. Do we have screenshots for VPC peering flows they want?
Sam: Yes — customer specifically asked for a VPC option and dedicated capacity diagram in the POC. I’ll confirm exact ACLs and share whatever they need.
Ashwin: For the "Encryption at Rest" Q we should reference the standard blurb + artifact path. Draft snippet:

```
All persistent model artifacts and cache are stored on AES-256 encrypted block storage. Keys are managed in KMS; for Private deployments customers may provide a CMK. Rotation policy: 90-day rotation for master keys. See artifact: s3://redwood-evidence/orchidbank/crypto/kms-rotation-report.pdf
```

Maria: Uploaded SOC2 bridge letter: s3://redwood-evidence/orchidbank/compliance/soc2-bridge-2025.pdf and arch diagram: s3://redwood-evidence/orchidbank/arch/redwood-arch-orchid-v2.pdf :white_check_mark:
Tay: Quick question — for the "Pen Test" Q, do we attach the full report or a redacted attestation? Legal prefers redacted until contract is signed.
Sam: Good call. For now attach the pen test attestation and offer full report under NDA. @Maria can you provide the attestation PDF?
Maria: Yes — pen test attestation uploaded: s3://redwood-evidence/orchidbank/security/pen-test-attestation-2024-11.pdf
deploy-bot: File uploaded to shared folder: /evidence/orchidbank/sig-v5 (SOC2, arch diagram, pen test attestation)
Ashwin: I’ll also add a small config snippet showing KMS alias usage and a proof of rotation (log snippet) so they can see rotations happened. Command I used to fetch key metadata:

`aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/redwood-orchid-prod`

I’ll paste the relevant output in the folder.
Tay: For multi-tenant isolation Q: short answer + diagram pointing to "redwood-arch-orchid-v2.pdf". Drafted a 3-line answer and linked it in the sheet.
Sam: Thanks — I filled the Customer-usage and Deployment Intent fields in the spreadsheet. Reminder: customer asked if we support customer-managed keys in Private — answer: yes, plus SR-ops runbook for key onboarding.
Ashwin: I'll review all draft answers tonight and flag any claims that need tighter artifacts. If anything high-risk, I’ll drop a :rotating_light: here.
Maria: FYI our last public pentest date is 2024-11-09. I added a short attestation text in the sheet under Q42.
Sam: Final step — I’ll stitch the Q&A into one zip and upload to the portal after Ashwin + Maria sign off. Target to send: tomorrow 12:00 PST.
Tay: I can do a quick pass for clarity at 09:30 tomorrow.
Ashwin: Signed off pending two minor wording tweaks.
Maria: Signed off.
Sam: Awesome — thanks team. I’ll ping the customer after upload and share link here. :pray:
